A string that contains a phrase fails the test unless it is in a region marked data-removed-ok in sdk/Update.html.in
or contains one of the fragments in "allow": the sentences that SAY a thing was removed. Add a phrase when a
feature is removed; add an allow fragment only for a sentence that states the removal, never to hide a stale one.
